offline_dashboard.help.message: Add saved local pages to a dashboard. Each page is copied when you save; later changes to the source page do not change this dashboard.

offline_dashboard.no_pages.message: Create and save a local page first.

offline_dashboard.export_caution.message: The package may contain internal information. Check your organization's rules before sharing it externally.

offline_dashboard.save_before_export.message: Save your changes before exporting the dashboard.

offline_dashboard.export_failed.message: The dashboard package could not be prepared. The saved dashboard was not changed.

offline_dashboard.failed.message: The dashboard could not be saved. Check page catalogs, roles and slots for conflicts.

offline_dashboard.conflict.message: This dashboard changed in another tab. Reopen it before saving.

offline_dashboard.reference_conflict.message: A source page defines the same widget reference more than once. Fix that page before adding it.

offline_dashboard.reference_unresolved.message: A source page has a widget link without a matching provider on that page. Fix the source page before adding it.

offline_dashboard.leave_dirty.message: Leave this dashboard with unsaved changes?

offline_dashboard.sources_fixed.message: This page belongs to a dashboard. Its source roles and catalog versions are shared with other pages; edit widgets and layout here.

offline_dashboard.page_load_failed.message: This dashboard page could not be opened.
